comparisons.family_title: Quasipolynomial algorithms for mean-payoff, stochastic and parity games
comparisons.theorem_locator: Theorem thm:main and explicit simple-stochastic-game reduction in section 1
comparisons.coverage: The deterministic algorithm has bit time 2^O((log(L+2))^2), which is quasipolynomial, not a fixed polynomial. The source explicitly reduces reachability >=1/2 to nonnegative expectation-of-liminf mean payoff with absorbing rewards +/-1, including nonabsorbing plays. AIM strict >1/2 is also obtainable: pure positional SSG values are rational with denominator at most 3^n by integer linear systems and Hadamard; positive 2v-1 is >=3^-n. Multiply all +/-1 rewards by 2*3^n and subtract 1 from every edge, so nonnegative mean payoff holds iff v>1/2. This has polynomial encoding length and preserves the quasipolynomial bound.
